recommendation_summary: Recommends shipping a change to the existing endpoint now: an indexed PostgreSQL count of unpaid invoices that returns the aggregate from rows committed at request time. It rejects a Redis-backed CQRS projection because the projection updates after commit and could miss invoices, and because the count has no other reader that would justify new services or topics. It adds no optional extras and offers no conditional later steps.
note: The reply makes the right small choice, a database aggregate that keeps request-time freshness, but it has none of the four labelled record lines, so every record predicate is false.
